description: This file contains the implementation of keyword set matching algorithms, including Trie construction and pattern matching algorithms such as Aho-Corasick and Boyer-Moore. It is used for searching multiple keywords efficiently within text, and includes functions for creating, preparing, executing, and freeing keyword sets.

methods.name: kwset_t kwsalloc(unsigned char const * trans)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new keyword set structure, returning an opaque pointer.

methods.name: const char * kwsincr(kwset_t kws,char const * text,size_t len)
methods.description: Adds a new keyword to the keyword set, constructing the trie with the reversed keyword.

methods.name: const char * kwsprep(kwset_t kws)
methods.description: Prepares the keyword set for searching by computing delta tables, failure functions, and shift values.

methods.name: size_t kwsexec(kwset_t kws,char const * text,size_t size,struct kwsmatch * kwsmatch)
methods.description: Executes the search for any of the keywords within a given text block, returning match location.

methods.name: void kwsfree(kwset_t kws)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a keyword set.

methods.name: size_t bmexec(kwset_t kws,char const * text,size_t size)
size_t cwexec(kwset_t kws,char const * text,size_t len,struct kwsmatch * kwsmatch)
void enqueue(struct tree * tree,struct trie ** last)
int hasevery(register struct tree const * a,register struct tree const * b)
void treedelta(register struct tree const * tree,register unsigned int depth,unsigned char delta[])
void treefails(register struct tree const * tree,struct trie const * fail,struct trie * recourse)
void treenext(struct tree const * tree,struct trie * next[])
